import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    path_source_0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_0.csv"
    path_source_1 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_1.csv"
    path_source_2 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_2.csv"
    path_source_3 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_3.csv"
    path_source_4 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_4.csv"

    # Output path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load source tables
    df_0 = pd.read_csv(path_source_0)  # ['IdInterv', 'Intervencion']
    df_1 = pd.read_csv(path_source_1)  # ['IdDeteccion', 'Deteccion']
    df_2 = pd.read_csv(path_source_2)  # main data with many columns including 'Intervencion', 'Deteccion', 'Actividad', 'Causa', etc.
    df_3 = pd.read_csv(path_source_3)  # ['IdActividad', 'Actividad']
    df_4 = pd.read_csv(path_source_4)  # ['IdCausa', 'Causa']

    # Step 1: Clean column names to avoid duplicates or trailing spaces
    # Strip column names in all dataframes
    for df in [df_0, df_1, df_2, df_3, df_4]:
        df.columns = df.columns.str.strip()

    # Step 2: Map textual categorical columns in df_2 to their corresponding Id columns using source tables
    # We will create mapping dictionaries from source tables for:
    # Intervencion -> IdInterv (from df_0)
    # Deteccion -> IdDeteccion (from df_1)
    # Actividad -> IdActividad (from df_3)
    # Causa -> IdCausa (from df_4)

    # Create mapping dictionaries (text -> id)
    intervencion_map = dict(zip(df_0['Intervencion'], df_0['IdInterv']))
    deteccion_map = dict(zip(df_1['Deteccion'], df_1['IdDeteccion']))
    actividad_map = dict(zip(df_3['Actividad'], df_3['IdActividad']))
    causa_map = dict(zip(df_4['Causa'], df_4['IdCausa']))

    # Step 3: Map the columns in df_2 to their respective Id columns using the above dictionaries
    # For safety, fill missing mappings with a default value (e.g., 0)
    df_2['IdInterv'] = df_2['Intervencion'].map(intervencion_map).fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_2['IdDeteccion'] = df_2['Deteccion'].map(deteccion_map).fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_2['IdActividad'] = df_2['Actividad'].map(actividad_map).fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_2['IdCausa'] = df_2['Causa'].map(causa_map).fillna(0).astype(int)

    # Step 4: Select and reorder columns to match the target schema exactly
    # Target schema:
    # ['Fecha': string, 'IdAhogado': integer, 'IdPersona': integer, 'Localidad': string, 'Provincia': string, 'CCAA': string,
    #  'Hora': string, 'Latitud_inc': float, 'Longitud_inc': float, 'Sexo': string, 'Edad': float, 'Nacionalidad': string,
    #  'Origen': string, 'Extraccion': string, 'Causa': string, 'TipoAhogamiento': string, 'Factor': string, 'Intervencion': string,
    #  'Pronostico': string, 'Localizacion': string, 'Riesgo': string, 'Reanimacion': string, 'Vigilancia': string, 'Actividad': string,
    #  'Deteccion': string, 'ID': integer, 'Estacion': string, 'Estado': string, 'Latitud_est': float, 'Longitud_est': float,
    #  'T_med': float, 'T_max': float, 'T_min': float, 'Presion': float, 'Dir. vi.': float, 'V_Viento': integer, 'Nubosidad': float,
    #  'ProfNievecm': float, 'InsolacHoras': float, 'Distancia': float, 'IdActividad': integer, 'IdCausa': integer, 'IdDeteccion': integer,
    #  'IdInterv': integer]

    # Note: Source df_2 has 'Precipitaciones' column which is not in target schema, so we exclude it.
    # Also, 'Dir. vi.' column name has a dot and space, keep exact spelling.

    # Ensure all required columns exist in df_2
    required_columns = [
        'Fecha', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora',
        'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion',
        'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion',
        'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion',
        'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min', 'Presion',
        'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia'
    ]

    # Check if any required column is missing in df_2
    missing_cols = [col for col in required_columns if col not in df_2.columns]
    if missing_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in source data (df_2): {missing_cols}")

    # Create final dataframe with all columns in order
    df_target = df_2[required_columns].copy()

    # Append the Id columns mapped from source tables
    df_target['IdActividad'] = df_2['IdActividad']
    df_target['IdCausa'] = df_2['IdCausa']
    df_target['IdDeteccion'] = df_2['IdDeteccion']
    df_target['IdInterv'] = df_2['IdInterv']

    # Step 5: Data type enforcement according to target schema
    # Convert columns to appropriate types

    # String columns
    str_cols = ['Fecha', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora', 'Sexo', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen',
                'Extraccion', 'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico',
                'Localizacion', 'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion',
                'Estacion', 'Estado']

    for col in str_cols:
        df_target[col] = df_target[col].astype(str).fillna('Sin datos')

    # Integer columns
    int_cols = ['IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'ID', 'V_Viento', 'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdInterv']
    for col in int_cols:
        # Some columns might have missing or float values, convert safely
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    # Float columns
    float_cols = ['Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Edad', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max',
                  'T_min', 'Presion', 'Dir. vi.', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia']

    for col in float_cols:
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce')

    # Step 6: Export the final dataframe to CSV
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
